content.short: HashLips NFT Smart Contracts is a collection of NFT project smart contracts written in Solidity by the HashLips community.
content.description: HashLips NFT Smart Contracts, founded by Daniel Eugene Botha, is a growing community of NFT enthusiasts building projects in Solidity. This open-source repository provides a collection of reusable Solidity smart contracts that developers can clone, deploy, and test to create NFT collections with ease. By offering widely adopted templates and active collaboration, the project has attracted a substantial following and extensive GitHub engagement, signaling quality, reliability, and broad community interest.
